title: 1620 Prairie's front door moves to where its engraving draws it
items: 1620 Prairie's front door now stands under the window above it, a little south of where it was, as the 1874 engraving draws it.
The stoop, its gate and the front walk stay where both old pictures put them, so the door opens at the south end of the landing, beside the terrace before the bay window.
